title: WebVH Server Domains — payload
description: Ask an agent which hosting domains it may use on one of the hosting servers it has registered. The agent answers by relaying the server's own caller-scoped view; the response items are the same DomainEntry the did-management family defines.

serverId.description: Identifier of the registered hosting server to ask. Required: an agent may know several, and they do not share a domain namespace — omitting it would make the answer ambiguous rather than general.

Response.title: WebVH Server Domains — response payload
Response.description: The success response. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vta/webvh/servers/domains/0.1#response.

domains.description: The domains the agent may use on that server, as the server reported them. Empty is a legitimate answer — a server the agent can reach but holds no domain grant on.

default.description: The domain used when a request names none — the caller's own default where the server records one, else the server's system default. Producers SHOULD omit it when there is neither; `null` is accepted as the same answer, and consumers MUST NOT read a difference between the two.
